ios.desc:
EXTENSION.app is the all-in-one extension app for iOS, iPadOS, iMessage, watchOS, macOS, tvOS and visionOS.

■■■ EXTENSION.app for iOS and iPadOS

■ In-App Web Browser:
- Automatic activation of "Picture-in-Picture" video mode on supported websites.
- Simultaneous playback of "Picture-in-Picture" video with other video apps, without sound.

■ In-App Video Picker:
- Selection of video files from Files app, iCloud Drive and On My Device directories.
- Selection of music videos from Music Library.
- Selection of videos from Photo Library.
- Simultaneous playback of "Picture-in-Picture" video with other video apps, with or without sound.

■ Share extensions:
- Player > Picture-in-Picture: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos.
- Player > Picture-in-Picture Mix: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos to play simultaneously with other video apps, without sound.
- Player > Fullscreen: extension activates Fullscreen mode for videos.
- Player > AirPlay: extension activates AirPlay for sharing video to another device.
- Player > Background Audio extension plays video in background.
- Supported apps: Safari, Photos, Files, Messages and other apps with a Share button.

■ Safari browser extensions:
- Player > Picture-in-Picture: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos.
- Player > Picture-in-Picture Mix: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos to play simultaneously with other video apps, without sound.
- Player > Fullscreen: extension activates Fullscreen mode for videos.
- Player > AirPlay: extension activates AirPlay for sharing video and audio to another device.
- Player > Background Audio extension plays video and audio in background.
- Player > Mute: extension mutes or unmutes video and audio.
- Player > Loop: extension loops video and audio playback.
- Player > Skip Forward and Backward: extension skips forward or backward 15 seconds of video and audio.
- Player > Next: extension skips to the next video and audio, or skips to the end of video and audio.

■ Shortcuts:
- Collection of Shortcuts to launch EXTENSION.app from Home Screen, Action Button, Tap Back or automation.
- "Browser" shortcut to open In-App Web Browser with On Screen website, Clipboard or list of suggested websites.
- "Browser > Favorite" shortcut to open favorite website.
- "Files" shortcut to open Files picker.
- "Photo Library" shortcut to open Photo Library picker.
